subject: Bullwong
text: Bullwongs have the highest Wizard's Ring drop rate, given as 3% or 1/32.

evidence.quote: Bullwongs have the highest drop rate for Wizard's Rings: 3% or 1/32.

subject: Horks
text: Horks drop the Wizard's Ring at 1/128 and are the only enemy in the basement of Road to Rhone.

evidence.quote: An alternative to the Bullwongs is Horks. While the drop rate is much lower at 1/128 instead of 1/32, you can find them much quicker. They're the only enemy that can appear in the basement of Road to Rhone, with a ridiculously high encounter rate.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: Using the Wizard's Ring at full MP does not trigger the achievement; MP must be restored in combat.

evidence.quote: Also keep in mind that if you use the Wizard's Ring when you have full MP, the achievement won't pop. You have to actually restore MP in combat to get the achievement!

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: A commenter advises selling Lottery Tickets and farming Bullwongs for the ring instead.

evidence.quote: Sell your Lottery Tickets, farming these from Bullwongs is where it's at, even if you aren't trying to grind your characters up to maximum levels.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: A free inventory slot is needed on each character or the ring will not drop.

evidence.quote: Es importante tener un slot libre en cada personaje, de lo contrario el item no caera.
evidence.translation: It is important to have a free slot on each character; otherwise the item will not drop.

subject: Road to Rhone
text: Casting Outside in Road to Rhone returns you to the entrance even if you entered from the exit.

evidence.quote: Note that casting Outside in Road to Rhone will take you to the entrance even if you entered from the exit, so you can reach the Hork Pit pretty quick even from the Rhone shrine.

subject: Horks
location: Hork basement in the cave of Rhone
text: A commenter gave up on Bullwongs and found a Wizard's Ring in the Hork basement of Rhone cave in about 20 minutes.

evidence.quote: Gave up and went into the Hork basement in the cave of Rhone and found one in 20 minutes.

subject: Goopi
text: A commenter got a Wizard's Ring from a Goopi fought randomly outside Beran.

evidence.quote: I was randomly fighting some Goopis outside of Beran and one of them dropped a Wizard's Ring.

subject: Bullwong
text: A commenter gained 200k XP fighting outside the Rhone Monolith and got no Bullwong drops.

evidence.quote: Ground out 200k xp outside the Rhone Monolith and didn't get a single item drop from Bullwong's.

subject: Bullwong
text: A commenter suggests counting Bullwong kills in a notepad until the 32nd.

evidence.quote: I suggest grinding them and count them and note themin a Notepad until you get to your 32nd.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: If the ring does not spawn, a commenter suggests saving and restarting the emulator.

evidence.quote: If it doesn't spawn, I suggest saving then restarting your emulator.

subject: Bullwong
text: Bullwongs can be fought comfortably at level 30 but are not guaranteed to spawn.

evidence.quote: You can pretty comfortably deal with Bullwongs once your hero hits level 30, but they're not guaranteed to spawn.

subject: Horks
text: Horks appear to be the only enemies on the lowest level of Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: Horks seem to be the only thing that spawn in the lowest level of Rhone Cave, and by the time you get there they shouldn't give you any real trouble.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: A commenter suggests disabling hardcore mode, saving a state, winning the ring from the lottery, then re-enabling hardcore before using it in battle.

evidence.quote: Easy way to get this one, disable hardcore make a save state and play the lottery, win the ring, save game, enable hardcore again (remember close and open the game). Use ring in battle cheevo will pop up, be happy.

subject: Metal Babble
text: A commenter got the Dragon Potion from their only Metal Babble kill.

evidence.quote: Got the dragon potion on my one and only metal babble kill

subject: Metal Babble
text: Metal Babbles appear in formations of 5 on the 3rd floor of Hargon's Castle.

evidence.quote: 3rd floor in Hargon's castle, they appear in formations of 5.

subject: Moonbrooke Castle secret basement NPC
text: An NPC in the Moonbrooke Castle secret basement explains how to get the 3rd party member.

evidence.quote: I mean... there's the dude who tells you how to pretty much get your 3rd party member, would be hard to know otherwise if you dont use online guides and stuff

subject: missing king of Tantegel
text: A commenter says the missing king of Tantegel is found at the weapons shop.

subject: metalbubble
text: Commenter got this ring when they killed metalbubble.

evidence.quote: As for me, I got this ring when I killed metalbubble.
